_notes.useM6: The interpreter refuses to run a program that never selects a tool, changer or not, and M6 is required alongside the T word.
_notes.pauseAfterToolChange: The control owns its tool-change procedure (a prompt or an ATC macro, set in its own parameters): an M0 on top of it would be a second stop the operator has to clear.
_notes.supportsCannedCycles: G81/G82 exist but with inverted retract semantics and no G80/G83/G73 to go with them. MachineProcessor's non-canned branch emits a full peck loop with dwell, so nothing is lost by leaving this off until the cycles are bench-verified.
_notes.dwellWord: G04 times on F, in seconds. P belongs to the G81/G82 cycles, in milliseconds.
_notes.rotary: No G93: feeds on mixed linear/rotary moves are honest at the reference radius and run fast below it.
_notes.defaults: generateHeader and generateFooter own the whole start and park sequence; these are the user's extras.
